title: Removing an applied coupon is a no-op server-side — placeOrder auto-applies the best offer anyway and burns a one-time reward
reason: needs-coordination — placeOrder treats any falsy couponCode (null or '') as 'auto-apply the best offer' (functions/src/orders/checkout.ts:373-375). There is no client-only way to express 'no coupon'; it needs a new `noCoupon` flag (or sentinel) in PlaceOrderSchema plus the matching wrapper change in web/src/components/checkout/checkout.ts — both outside my file list.

title: products.soldCount is never incremented on order placement, so popularity sort and the dashboard category chart are permanently zero
reason: needs-coordination — the defect is that nothing writes soldCount; the fix belongs in the placeOrder transaction (functions/src/orders/checkout.ts, alongside the stock decrement) and in performCancellation / approved returns. ListingView.tsx's `b.soldCount - a.soldCount` sort is correct as written and cannot fix it client-side.

title: Return window is hardcoded to 3 days server-side but the storefront gates on settings/returns.windowDays (finding #1)
reason: already-fixed — functions/src/returns/requests.ts:33-66 now reads settings/returns.windowDays (default 7), treats <=0 as returns-disabled, and measures from deliveredAt ?? placedAt ?? createdAt. The remaining half (app/lib/features/orders/data/order.dart returnWindowDays = 3) is a Dart file outside my assigned file list — needs-coordination.

title: broadcasts.opened is written once as 0 and never updated, so the Opened column is always 0
reason: needs-coordination — the only non-UI fix is a Firestore document trigger on customers/{uid}/notifications that increments broadcasts/{id}.opened; that requires a new export wired into functions/src/index.ts (outside my file list), and it also contradicts the codebase's stated "no document triggers" rule (functions/src/affiliate/commissions.ts:4-5). The alternative in the finding — removing the Opened column — is a forbidden UI change.

title: CF idempotency replay returns totalPaise instead of payablePaise (functions/src/orders/checkout.ts)
reason: needs-coordination — the second half of the findOrderByNonce finding. checkout.ts is outside my assigned file list (another agent may be editing functions/), so I did not touch it.

title: Reports: switch to getDocs + useMemo, and scope the queries to the selected range
reason: needs-coordination — the range lives in ReportsPage.tsx state and the hooks are called with no arguments; scoping per range, memoising computeKpis/computeTrend/computeTopProducts, and swapping onSnapshot for getDocs all require editing ReportsPage.tsx (and, for customers/orderRequests, the shared cache keys owned by the customers and returns features). I bounded the orders listener to the widest usable window instead — see fixed.

title: Category performance: drive labels/tints from the live categories collection and aggregate order revenue over the selected range
reason: needs-coordination — categoryPerformance(products) is called from DashboardPage.tsx with products only; joining the categories collection or per-range order revenue needs new arguments/hooks at that call site, which is outside my assigned files.

title: Coupon 'Category restriction' (applicableCategories) is written but never enforced
reason: needs-coordination — admin/src/features/coupons/api/coupons.ts already persists applicableCategories correctly; the missing enforcement is in functions/src/orders/checkout.ts (computeCouponDiscount / autoBestOffer) and web/src/components/checkout/offers.ts, both outside my assigned file list. Note for whoever picks it up: admin stores category *slugs*, so the server check must compare against each line's categorySlug/categoryId.

title: Changing a category tint fans out writes to products (denied for a categories-only sub-admin; partial-failure risk)
reason: needs-coordination — the correct fix is to move fanOutCategoryTint into a Cloud Function gated by requireModule(req,'categories','edit') (functions/), or to have web/app readers derive categoryTint from the category doc instead of the denormalised product field. Both live outside admin/. I deliberately did not add a client-side workaround, since any in-admin change would only mask the permission denial rather than fix it.

title: `settings/returns.autoRefundToWallet` is a dead toggle — no code ever reads it (StorefrontTab.tsx:329)

The real fix is in functions/src/returns/decisions.ts (read settings/returns and branch the refund), which is outside my assigned files. reason: needs-coordination — duplicate of the finding above, same root cause, same blocker (server-side change in functions/src/returns/decisions.ts, or a UI removal).

title: The `payments` collection is never written by any Cloud Function — Payments module only shows seeded rows (payments.ts:9)
reason: needs-coordination — duplicate of the finding above, same root cause, same blocker (functions/src/orders/checkout.ts).

title: Review moderation writes products/{id}, so a reviews-only sub-admin cannot approve anything (reviews.ts:64)
reason: needs-coordination — verified still true: firebase/firestore.rules:51 still gates products writes on `canWrite('products')` while reviews moderation is its own module, and the transaction is all-or-nothing. Both viable fixes (a `moderateReview` callable guarded by `requireModule(req,'reviews','approve')`, or widening the products rule for a rating-only diff) live in functions/ or firebase/firestore.rules, outside my assigned files. Splitting the transaction inside reviews.ts was rejected: it would let the review flip to 'approved' while the aggregate write fails, and re-approving is a no-op, so the rating could never be repaired.

title: Review moderation writes the products doc, so a sub-admin with only the reviews module gets permission-denied (reviews.ts:64, security)
reason: needs-coordination — duplicate of the finding above, same root cause, same blocker (firestore.rules / a Cloud Function).

Both remaining fixes (the web query, or a scheduled sweep / lazy flip in functions/src/spin/execute.ts) are outside my files. admin/src/features/spinner/api/spinner.ts already derives 'Ended' correctly from the window (deriveSpinStatus:72-76) — there is nothing left to change there.
